caveat: The 5 m surface fills pixels without LOLA returns by interpolation (README); only about 10% of 5 m pixels hold returns, so short lags of 'all_cells' are shaped by the interpolation. 'observed_cells_only' uses pairs of cells that both hold returns (ldec > 0).
site: PGDA78 Site01 (Connecting Ridge), whole 16 x 16 km product at native 5 m

site_rosenburg_side_by_side.note: Side by side only. Different baselines and surface types: Rosenburg et al. fit LOLA profile deviograms over their own baseline range per terrain type (global highlands and maria), we fit a 90 m grid deviogram over 270-1080 m lags in 5 km south-polar windows.
